author: StewieFG
body:
Hello,

I've noticed that the Team Death Match gamemode is too similar to the Nexus gamemode, and no one plays it however players want to play nexus more. I suggest removing team deathmatch and maybe placign these maps on nexus which will make people play nexus more since I don't see a big difference between nexus and team-death match.

Opinions?

EDIT: About maps like Venomous TDM, and OiTN too should be not moved, but normal TDM maps should be moved. That's not the gamemode, we have nexus for that.
